purpose: paired frozen-backbone screen before any expensive APEX fine-tuning

arms.a0: real proposal positives and negatives only
arms.a1: a0 plus LMP jitter hard negatives and fine/scale prototype margins
arms.a1m: a1 with weighted BCE and within-source score-near TP>FP ranking MLP
arms.a3m: matched MLP plus fully reviewed Background-100MP active-FP negatives
arms.a4: a1 plus a2; forbidden unless a1 and a2 independently pass

calibration.split: stable source-group hash modulo 5 equals zero

coarse_module_policy: ship and vehicle are admitted independently; a failed vehicle arm cannot invalidate or silently enter a passing ship arm
d4_policy: D4 mean embedding is evaluated only after the identity Ship module is positive on Normal, Hard and Sentinel-B
